tokens.name: sunny
tokens.usage: The Happy half of the mark. Primary buttons, highlight fills, the warm side of any two-tone moment. Never text: put `on-sunny` on it.

tokens.name: sunny-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for anything painted `sunny`. `on-sunny` holds 10.3:1 on it.

tokens.name: sunny-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet warm background for badges and highlighted rows. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it in both themes.

tokens.name: on-sunny
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `sunny` and `sunny-hover` (13:1). Stays dark in both themes because sunny does.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: The Cynic half of the mark. Fills, large graphics, icons and display text 24px+. Only 3.0:1 on white and 2.9:1 on `surface`, so never body text: use `teal-ink`.

tokens.name: teal-ink
tokens.usage: Teal for text: links, the accent line of a headline, eyebrows. 5.4:1 on `surface`, 5.6:1 on `surface-raised`; dark 8.4:1 on `surface`, 6.9:1 on `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: teal-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet cool background for badges and info notes. `teal-ink` reads on it (4.9:1 light, 6.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text on a `teal` fill (5.9:1). White on teal is only 3.0:1: allowed for 24px+ type, nothing smaller.

tokens.name: logo-ink
tokens.usage: The pure black outline of the face and the wordmark. Reserved for the mark and illustrations drawn in its style; UI text uses `ink`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body copy and nav on `surface`, `surface-raised` and both tints (17:1+ light, 16:1+ dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting paragraphs, descriptions, captions on `surface` and `surface-raised` (7.2:1 light, 5.7:1 dark on raised).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Meta text, timestamps and placeholder text on `surface-raised` and `surface` (4.55:1 minimum). The floor: nothing lighter carries text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Header, cards, alternating page sections, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Footer and other deliberately dark bands. Pair with `on-inverse` and `on-inverse-muted`.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Primary text on `surface-inverse` (17:1).

tokens.name: on-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface-inverse`, such as the footer tagline (7:1 light, 7.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: section dividers, card outlines that sit on a contrasting ground. Not enough for a control's edge.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning: inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes (3:1+ on both surfaces in both themes).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element. 5.4:1+ on every surface in its theme.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status text and icons. Always paired with a word or icon; teal against `danger` orange stays distinguishable for colour-blind readers.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, text or icon, on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `danger-tint` (4.7:1+ light, 6.5:1+ dark).

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of an error note or badge, with `danger` text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution fill with `on-sunny` text. Use sparingly: sunny is the brand's happy colour, not an alarm.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The happycynic.com home hero only, in place of `display` (`hc-hero__title--xl`). Two lines, the second in `teal-ink`; drops to 40px on phones.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the hero headline. Two lines, the second in `teal-ink`.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: We design tools for people who are smart enough to question most apps.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs under a display or headline, in `ink-muted`, at most `measure` wide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Packing lists that know the weather, your destination, and your chaotic reality.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: We build clever tools for people who don’t fall for buzzwords.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a headline and the endorsement line, echoing the spaced SOFTWARE of the logo. Always uppercase, in `teal-ink`.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code, keyboard shortcuts, technical asides.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The base unit. Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: badge padding, title to meta.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Nav item gaps, headline to paragraph.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on phones, button horizontal padding, card padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Paragraph to call-to-action; page gutter on tablets.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of every page section.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs, code chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and notes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Feature panels, app-icon-like tiles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons (always pills) and anything circular, like the face itself.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards on `surface`.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: The site header, popovers. The only elevation most pages need.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of a paragraph block (about 70 characters at `body-lg`).

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max width of a centred content section.
